To figure out whether you can do both—**and which one saves more money**—I first need to authenticate you.

2) Are the items you mentioned from the **same order** or **different orders**? If you know them, please share the **order ID(s)** (e.g., `#W0000000`).  
3) Are all of those items already **delivered**?
